comments.author: mruiz
comments.body: During the screening call, we reviewed the provisional access to the campaign analytics portal. The SummerBoost campaign underperformed by 22% against projections, which highlights the need for better monitoring.

comments.author: mruiz
comments.body: Specifically, the click-through rate for the 18-24 demographic was below 1.2%, indicating a gap in targeting.

comments.author: mruiz
comments.body: Given the poor attribution modeling from AdScan, BrightPath is considering terminating their vendor contract.

description: As part of the BrightPath campaign analytics dashboard request, we need to implement a dashboard that visualizes key marketing metrics. Acceptance criteria: Verify the dashboard correctly displays daily unique visitors from UTM parameters; Ensure error handling when campaign end dates are missing in the data feed; Check that the timezone selector updates all time-series graphs without full page reload.
